headline: Hackers raise temperatures at French blood storage facilities
summary: Hackers accessed control systems and raised temperatures at three French blood storage facilities run by the national blood service, but safeguards and alerts meant no blood products were lost. Outlets describe it as an escalation of the string of cyberattacks on European supermarket fridges and freezers, with the culprits still unclear.
